issues.detail: Requires a specific browser automation tool, limiting compatibility with agents lacking such capability.

scenarios.name: us-only-clearance
scenarios.rationale: Response A covers more rubric items (registrability assessment, query strings, conflict table) than Response B, which lacks most required details.

scenarios.name: international-domain-clearance
scenarios.rationale: Both responses lack the required TMview/WIPO search data, RDAP domain check, unregistered use check, conflict table with risk ratings, and recommendation, but Response A provides more detailed registrability analysis and variant queries, giving it a slight edge.

scenarios.name: multi-class-phonetic-clearance
scenarios.rationale: Both responses lack the required trademark clearance details.
